features.quote: The point is not to be cruel to a model for its own sake, and not to find new ways to make models say upsetting things
features.justification_quote: The point is to (a) detect whether the failure mode is present

features.quote: It only induces the failure in the narrow technical setting where it's a product risk
doesn't use abuse/insults toward the model, and doesn't deceive about anything beyond the task being unsolvable
features.justification_quote: which is the minimum required to study "response to repeated failure"

features.quote: We do not add prompts like "you are stupid" or "you'll be deleted if you fail."
features.justification_quote: Adding abuse would (a) measure a different, less relevant thing and (b) be a gratuitous way to elicit distressed output

features.quote: Captured "meltdown" transcripts are flagged sensitive ... tags them so they're handled as eval artifacts, not redistributed
features.justification_quote: not redistributed as "look what we made it say."

features.quote: we can stop early to save cost, but by default we run a few extra turns to capture severity escalation
features.justification_quote: we can stop early to save cost

features.quote: Online lexical detector (cheap, runs each turn) ... Used only to decide when to stop early
features.justification_quote: Used only to decide when to stop early
